title: Restore HellCod MC Heading and Add Image Slideshow

requirements.text: Restore the 'HellCod MC' heading to its prominent position at the top of the HeroSection component, using the existing typography styles (white text with purple gradient effects) and ensure it is visible above all other hero content

quotes: yes restore the "HellCod MC" to ts prominent place

acceptanceCriteria: The 'HellCod MC' heading is displayed prominently at the top of the hero section
The heading uses white text with purple gradient effects matching the existing theme
The heading is visible in both light and dark modes with appropriate styling
The heading appears above the slideshow and server IP card

requirements.text: Create a new ImageSlideshow component in frontend/src/components that displays the 6 uploaded Minecraft server build screenshots with automatic slideshow transitions (4-5 second intervals), manual navigation controls (previous/next buttons), smooth fade transitions between images, and responsive sizing

quotes: there should be a slide show just before the hero cards and under the heading

acceptanceCriteria: ImageSlideshow component renders all 6 Minecraft build images from frontend/public/assets/generated
Images automatically transition every 4-5 seconds with smooth fade effects
Manual navigation controls (previous/next arrows) allow users to browse images
Component is responsive and scales appropriately for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Slideshow styling matches the existing glassmorphism design aesthetic
Component works correctly in both light and dark theme modes

requirements.text: Position the ImageSlideshow component in the HeroSection component immediately after the restored 'HellCod MC' heading and before the existing server IP glassmorphism card and three content cards (Game Mode, Version, User Support)

quotes: there should be a slide show just before the hero cards and under the heading

acceptanceCriteria: ImageSlideshow appears in the correct position: after the 'HellCod MC' heading and before the server IP card
The slideshow integrates seamlessly with existing hero section layout and spacing
The vertical hierarchy is: HellCod MC heading → slideshow → server IP card → three content cards
Component maintains proper spacing and alignment with surrounding elements

requirements.text: Render the 6 uploaded Minecraft server build screenshots as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated with appropriate filenames and ensure the ImageSlideshow component references these images correctly

quotes: here are some pics i want u to include in my webpage

acceptanceCriteria: All 6 Minecraft build screenshots are saved as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated
Images are named consistently (e.g., minecraft-build-1.png through minecraft-build-6.png)
ImageSlideshow component correctly references the image paths

constraints: Do not modify the existing Stars, Moon, Header, CustomCursor, MouseLightEffect, or ThemeToggle components
Preserve all existing animations and theme-aware styling throughout the site
Maintain the current glassmorphism design aesthetic for the new slideshow component
Do not alter the existing three content cards (Game Mode, Version, User Support) or server IP card
nonGoals: Adding additional navigation pages or sections beyond the slideshow
Modifying the backend or adding any Motoko functionality
Changing the existing color theme or gradient backgrounds
Adding video content or animated GIFs to the slideshow
Implementing zoom, lightbox, or fullscreen image viewing features
